hints.title: Complement Matching
hints.text: Finding two numbers that sum to a target does not require checking every pair. For each element x, there is exactly one value target - x that completes the sum. Can you check whether that complement was already seen in constant time?

hints.title: Hash Table Index Map
hints.text: Maintain a hash table mapping each visited number to its index in the array. As you scan from left to right, every previous element is immediately queryable.

hints.title: Single-Pass Lookup and Insert
hints.text: For each element nums[i], first check if target - nums[i] exists in the map. If it does, return [seen[target - nums[i]], i]. If not, record seen[nums[i]] = i and continue.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of nums array (2 <= N <= 10^4)
complexity.notes: Single pass over nums with O(1) average hash table lookups and insertions.
